name: RC-B10-0110/2026 – § 10 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text: 10. Calls for the EU and its Member States to provide protection and humanitarian assistance to people facing a serious risk to life, to suspend forced returns to Iran from EU Member States, and to support solutions to restore internet access;
